spans.s:
Milk.
f. (-या)
1 Rice gruel.
2 Decoction of any thing after straining.
3 Any drink with a small quantity of boiled rice.
4 Anise, (Pimpinella anisum.)
E.
पा to drink, aff. यत्.

mn. (-षः-षं)
1 The milk of a cow, which has calved within seven days.
2 Fresh

Amṛta or nectar.
E.
पीय Sautra root, for पा to drink, ऊसुन् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel changed; otherwise पीयूष, q. v.
